notes: dc CALL 2026-08-12 Q2 2026 call (AV transcript, one call used). Q3 2026 results not yet reported at as_of; none of the Q2 documents is within 2 days of 2026-11-01.

dc MGMT (call) Q2 landmark deals: four deals averaging over $1B each (Reflection, Cohere, a scaled US new lab, a large US quant firm), $20-25M per MW per year, upfront payments 50-60% of associated capex; management says it could sell all 2027 capacity on these terms but retains some for short-term deals at $40-50M per MW.

dc MGMT first capacity auction cleared 15% above the highest Blackwell price charged before; asset-light partnership model introduced; Vera Rubin deployment expected late 2026 or early 2027; formal 2027 guidance promised later in 2026; over 1 GW of new capacity planned in 2027; margin improvement from own data centers expected from H2 2027.

dc MGMT 2026 guidance reaffirmed on 2026-08-12 (ARR 7-9B, revenue 3.0-3.4B, adjusted EBITDA margin about 40%, capex 20-25B, 800-1000 MW connected power); new capacity deals come online late 2026 and have no material effect on 2026 revenue. Implied H2 revenue 2.0-2.4B against H1 0.98B.

dc FACT Q2 operating loss 175.9M includes 74.9M SBC and 41.0M post-combination compensation from the Eigen AI acquisition (non-recurring) and 36M acquisition and financing professional fees. Server useful life extended from 4 to 5 years from 2026 (lowers depreciation).
dc FACT Q2 net loss from continuing operations 190.4M; H1 net income 430.8M is driven by 780.6M ClickHouse revaluation gain (non-operating, one-off) and 182.8M interest expense on convertibles.

dc FACT Operating cash flow H1 4,504.1M is driven by 4,395.0M increase in deferred revenue (customer prepayments, partly refundable per note); free cash flow after 8,130.3M capex is about -3.6B in H1.

dc FACT Funding H1 2026: convertibles 4,337.5M gross, treasury share sales 2,846.7M, prefunded warrants to NVIDIA 2,000.0M. Q2 ATM 12.7M Class A shares at $224 average, 12.3M shares remain. July 2026 asset-backed facility $775M at SOFR+250bp.

dc FACT Subsequent financings in releases: proposed 4.50B convertible senior notes (2.75B due 2030, 1.75B due 2034) announced 2026-08-19 (pricing and closing not read here); 3.5B Citi financing facility 2026-10-22; Inferize acquisition 2026-10-01.

dc FACT Contracts (20-F): Microsoft agreement total contract value up to about 17.4B through 2031; Meta five-year order about 2.88B initial plus further orders with total contract value 12B and an unsold-capacity access order; Meta/Microsoft service credits and tranche termination rights on delivery delays.

dc FACT RPO 37,490.6M at 2026-06-30: 36% within 24 months to June 2028, 40% months 25-48, rest later; all Nebius AI cloud. Uncommenced leases 12,054.1M undiscounted, commencing 2026-2027, terms up to 12 years.
dc FACT Long-lived assets 14,984.2M at 2026-06-30 (US 9,043.2, Netherlands 4,832.5, Finland 340.9, Israel 289.1, other 478.5).
dc RISK 20-F Item 3.D: core business capital-intensive and not profitable, depends on raising equity or debt (dilution, financing terms).
dc RISK 20-F Item 3.D: limited experience delivering multi-year contracts (Meta, Microsoft) at scale: service credits, termination rights on delay, penalties, cost overruns.
dc RISK 20-F Item 3.D: customer concentration; three customers were 24%, 21% and 14% of Q2 2026 revenue, unnamed; Q2 2025 had two at 39% and 15%.
dc RISK 20-F Item 3.D: competition from CoreWeave, Crusoe, Lambda and from AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Oracle; pricing pressure; AI models needing less compute could reduce demand.
dc RISK 20-F Item 3.D: supply chain and export controls, tariffs and sanctions on GPUs and hardware; three suppliers carried the Q2 2026 capex.
dc RISK call Q2: US site risk (Vineland NJ public hearing adjourned without a vote; power moved to Bloom fuel cells); data-center power availability and construction timing decide revenue timing.
dc RISK 20-F: Avride (autonomous vehicles) is capital-intensive and early stage, adjusted EBITDA loss 40.1M in Q2 2026; TripleTen revenue declining (-19% y/y in Q2).
